sub_service: Leakage, pollution, meter replacement, minor/major repairs, hand pump/borewell repairs, chlorination, tanker supply
problem_type: Water leakage, pipeline damage, contaminated water supply, low/no supply
department: Water Supply wing, Office of the City Engineer, CCMC
authority: Junior Engineer / Assistant Engineer of the relevant sub-division (first contact)
description: CCMC's Citizen's Charter publishes a response-time table covering water-supply complaints and defects: replacement of a defective meter, rectification of pollution in drinking water, arresting leakage of water in the mains, minor and major repairs, repairs to hand pumps/public fountains/India Mark 2 pumps and borewells, deficiency in chlorination, prevention of fire, and emergency tanker supply when piped supply is interrupted or for marriages/festivals. The city is served by four water-supply schemes (Siruvani, Pillur, Aliyar, Bhavani) delivering to household connections and public stand posts via 126 storage reservoirs and 2,380 km of distribution network.
procedure: Report to the Junior Engineer/Assistant Engineer of the relevant sub-division (contact list published by area). If unresolved, escalate to the Zonal Assistant Executive Engineer / Assistant Commissioner (second contact), then to the Zonal Executive Engineer (third contact).
sla: Replacement of defective meter: 15 days. Rectification of pollution in drinking water supply: within 24 hours. Arresting of leakage of water in the mains: within 24 hours. Minor repairs: 2 days. Major repairs: 3 days. Repairs to hand pumps: 3 days. Repairs to public fountains: 2 days. Repairs to India Mark 2 pumps/borewells: 7 days. Deficiency in chlorination: within 24 hours. Prevention of fire: at once. Supply of water through tanker lorry, if piped supply is interrupted: within 24 hours. Supply of water through lorry for marriage/festival: 3-5 days.
expected_response_time: 24 hours for leakage, pollution, and chlorination-deficiency complaints
expected_resolution_time: 2-3 days for minor/major repairs; up to 15 days for meter replacement
complaint_channel: In person or by phone to the Junior Engineer / Assistant Engineer of the relevant sub-division
contact_information: First contact (sub-division level): Ganapathy MSR (J.E./A.E.) 2511911; Bharathi Park HLR 2442236; Gandhi Park LLR 2471009; Singanallur 2573172; Sungam 2312267; Goundampalayam 2400577; Sundarapuram 2676700; Thudiyalur 2642542 -- all available 8:00-10:00 AM and 3:30-5:30 PM. Second contact (zone level): East 2572696/9442104100/9443799207; West 2551700/9443799219/9489206055; North 2513133/9442104109/9442501877; South 2252482/9442104110/9489206001; Central 2215618/9442104124/9489206045 (Office/AEE/AC phone numbers respectively). Third contact (Executive Engineer): East & North Zone 94437 99243; West & South Zone 9442104113; Central Zone 94437 44445.
escalation_procedure: First contact: Junior Engineer/Assistant Engineer of the relevant sub-division. Second contact: Zonal Assistant Executive Engineer or Assistant Commissioner. Third contact: Zonal Executive Engineer.
escalation_authority: Zonal Executive Engineer (East & North Zone / West & South Zone / Central Zone)

faq.question: How fast should a water leakage in the mains be fixed?
faq.answer: Within 24 hours, per CCMC's Citizen's Charter response-time table.

citizen_guidance: Avoid wastage of water and do not use drinking water for gardening. Avoid unauthorised drawing of water or use of motor pumps on Corporation connections. Get repairs attended only after intimating the Corporation and under Corporation Engineering staff supervision. Pay water charges promptly to avoid disconnection. Conserve rain water and build rain-water-harvesting structures. Report water leakage and theft. Do not tamper with the water-supply connection or meter.
source_title: Citizen's Charter — Coimbatore City Municipal Corporation

sub_service: Drainage blockage/leakage, missing manhole lid, septic tank cleaning, new sewerage connection
problem_type: Sewage/drain blockage or leakage; missing manhole lid; septic tank needing cleaning
department: Underground Sewerage Scheme, Office of the City Engineer, CCMC
authority: Junior Engineer / Assistant Engineer of the relevant zone (first contact)
description: CCMC's Underground Drainage (UGD) system, functioning since 1983-1994 in the older zones (52.30 km at charter publication, ~19,000 connections), was being extended to all 8 zones via a project administratively sanctioned by the Ministry of Urban Development, Government of Tamil Nadu (G.O. (D) No. 25 (3D) MA & WS (MA-II) Dept., dated 24.10.2007), including three sewage treatment plants at Ukkadam (70 MLD), Nanjundapuram (40 MLD), and Ondipudur (60 MLD), aiming for 71,200 total sewerage connections.
procedure: Report blockage/leakage or a missing manhole lid to the zonal Junior Engineer/Assistant Engineer; escalate through the same zone/Executive Engineer structure as water-supply complaints.
sla: Complaints of blockage/leakage of drainage: within 24 hours. Rectification of defects in drainage connection: 2 days. Replacement of missing manhole lid: within 24 hours. New sewerage connection: acknowledgement on the spot, defect intimation within 7 days, fee-remittance notice within 7 days after rectification, commissioning within 15 days of fee remittance. Septic tank cleaning: within 2 days of application/fee payment.
expected_response_time: 24 hours for blockage/leakage and missing manhole lids
expected_resolution_time: 2 days for drainage-connection defects; 15 days for a new connection end-to-end
complaint_channel: In person or by phone to the zonal Junior Engineer / Assistant Engineer
contact_information: First contact (sub-division level): Ganapathy MSR (J.E./A.E.) 2511911; Bharathi Park HLR 2442236; Gandhi Park LLR 2471009; Singanallur 2573172; Sungam 2312267; Goundampalayam 2400577; Sundarapuram 2676700; Thudiyalur 2642542 -- all available 8:00-10:00 AM and 3:30-5:30 PM. Second contact (zone level): East 2572696/9442104100/9443799207; West 2551700/9443799219/9489206055; North 2513133/9442104109/9442501877; South 2252482/9442104110/9489206001; Central 2215618/9442104124/9489206045 (Office/AEE/AC phone numbers respectively). Third contact (Executive Engineer): East & North Zone 94437 99243; West & South Zone 9442104113; Central Zone 94437 44445.
escalation_procedure: Same three-tier structure as water-supply complaints: zonal Junior Engineer/Assistant Engineer, then Assistant Executive Engineer/Assistant Commissioner, then Executive Engineer.
escalation_authority: Zonal Executive Engineer (East & North Zone / West & South Zone / Central Zone)
citizen_guidance: Do not throw other waste, including animal waste and debris, into sewage lines. Do not connect sewage outlets to public open drains or roadsides. Follow safety measures before entrusting septic tank cleaning to private persons. Do not tamper with sewage connections. Pay tax and service charges promptly.
source_title: Citizen's Charter — Coimbatore City Municipal Corporation

service_name: Solid Waste Management — Street Cleaning & Garbage Collection
sub_service: Daily street sweeping, garbage/debris removal, public toilet cleaning, dead-animal removal
problem_type: Uncollected garbage, unswept streets, blocked public toilets, uncollected debris
description: Solid waste management is a Health Department function covering the city's 105.88 sq.km across 100 wards, generating about 500 tonnes of waste per day, collected via 1,549 dustbins and 2,423 containers by 2,740 sanitary workers using hand-drawn push carts. Functions include daily street cleaning, night sweeping of bus stands/markets, debris removal, bulk-waste clearance at large venues, public toilet/urinal cleaning, and dead-animal removal.
procedure: Report to the Sanitary Inspector of the ward; escalate to the Zonal Sanitary Officer, then the Corporation Health Officer.
sla: Cleaning of streets and roads: Monday-Saturday, 5:30-10:30 AM and 2:30-5:30 PM, at all places. Market and bus-stand cleaning: 9:00 PM to 4:00 AM the next day. Collection and removal of garbage: daily. Cleaning of public toilets and urinals: daily. Complaints regarding non-removal of garbage: within 24 hours. Removal of dead animals: within 24 hours. Complaints regarding non-sweeping of roads: within 24 hours. Complaints regarding removal of debris: 3 days from intimation. Complaints regarding removal of blockages in public toilets: within 24 hours.
expected_response_time: 24 hours for non-removal-of-garbage and non-sweeping complaints
complaint_channel: In person or by phone to the ward Sanitary Inspector
contact_information: Zonal Sanitary Officer (second contact) and Corporation Health Officer (third contact) — no ward-level phone table published in this section; City Health Officer 2395156, Commissioner 2390261 (published elsewhere in the charter).
escalation_procedure: First contact: Sanitary Inspector. Second contact: Zonal Sanitary Officer. Third contact: Corporation Health Officer.
citizen_guidance: Do not throw waste into open drains or streets. Clean your premises and deposit waste at designated points before conservancy staff arrive. Segregate household waste into degradable and non-degradable. Report non-clearance of garbage/debris to the designated authorities. Keep premises clean, remove bushes/shrubs and prune trees abutting main streets. Use public toilets/urinals properly. Pay administrative charges and fees promptly.
source_title: Citizen's Charter — Coimbatore City Municipal Corporation

sub_service: Pothole filling, patch work, natural-calamity damage restoration, encroachment/debris removal
problem_type: Potholes, damaged roads, road obstruction, water stagnation on roads
department: Office of the City Engineer, CCMC
authority: Junior Engineer / Assistant Engineer of the relevant zone (first contact)
description: CCMC maintains 170.37 km of concrete roads, 1,347.40 km of B.T.-surface roads, 426.67 km of metal roads, and 182.75 km of earthen roads within city limits; the National Highways department separately maintains 7.46 km and the State Highways department 3.20 km of B.T.-surface roads inside Corporation limits.
procedure: Report to the zonal Junior Engineer/Assistant Engineer; escalate through the AEE/AC and Executive Engineer tiers.
sla: Restoration of damage caused by natural calamities: 3 days. Filling of potholes in the roads: 10 days. Road-cutting permission: 7 days. Patch work on roads: 30 days. Removal of encroachments causing hindrance to traffic: 3 days. Replacing missing manhole lids on drains: 3 days. Removal of debris/construction materials on road sides by the building owner: 1 week; if not removed by the owner, Corporation removal on collection of expenses: 1 week. Rectification of water stagnation: within 24 hours. Repair of drainage blockage (emergency): within 24 hours.
expected_response_time: 24 hours for water-stagnation and emergency drainage-blockage complaints
expected_resolution_time: 10 days for pothole filling; 30 days for patch work

Avoid cutting roads without permission. Do not allow household waste water to flow onto the streets or throw garbage into drains. Report water stagnation, missing manhole lids, and damaged lights/poles. Maintain avenue trees in front of premises.
